notes.title: New Update is Released with BIG DISCOUNT for a limited time!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/02ed0ca02ba477aef638f8f81ad6062bf03bc971.png[/img]

Hello Good People of Sivashills. I am happy to announce that I have updated On the Dragon Wings with new features, bug fixes, execution improvement, etc. Before BIG update (New Dragons with new 31 exciting Tasks), I wanted to make the game more stable. Let's talk about what I have done: 🤗

[b]AHHH AND BIG SALE STARTS TODAY (%70 🤩)[/b]

[b]1. Character Portraits are Re-Designed[/b]
I have redesigned our characters' portait images in the Status Panel. They are looking much more better now. We will see these faces more and more in the incoming 31 tasks (In future).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/5a06e6a5e069965abe71f7bb88e71089af8ba41a.jpg[/img]

[b]2. Visuals are added on Story Telling[/b]
Now we have visuals on the story telling area. When we are listening the story of our characters in the beginning of the game, these visuals are helping us for better understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/1a6833be8938e2dd4889df136e50cd536d2b5483.png[/img]

[b]3. Main Menu Theme is Updated[/b]
Our main menu was a bit dark themed. But I have changed it and made it more positive. Now, when we are on the main menu, we feel more hopeful and positive before fighting against Dark Rider 😅 And Dragon is updated. Now, we see Red Breath Dragon flying instead of Dark Skin Dragon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/61fb929822d9c676add37d110c4391ea79d36612.png[/img]

[b]4. Collapsable Enemy Watch Towers[/b]
When we burn the enemy towers, they collapse with an animation and we see the enemy archer flying in ragdoll mode. This looks awesome and it gives more satisfaction to Dragon Rider.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/b04b8d7b0178939fa1becab1a58490173a8eeb8c.png[/img]

[b]5. Jump and floating in the air Bug is Fixed[/b]
When player jumps and is very close to an edge of object, the player was floating in the air. It is fixed in this version. 👏

I hope you like the updates, guys. And Don't forget to catch this big sale %70 this week.

Kind Regards,
Queen Developer

notes.title: Big Update is Released! Lots of New Challenges on the Map and Fighting Mechanics
notes.content:
Hi Dear Dragon Lovers! This is Queen Developer. I am pleased to announce that On the Dragon Wings is updated! We have lots of new improvements, game mechanics and Challenges on the Sivashills Island. You can find the details listed below:

[h3]Improved Fighting System with New Animations and Particles![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/451d5589a355b3837a670581ce6683b34a54757c.gif[/img]

Our Heroes have got better fighting skills now. New smashing and swinging particles are added. Enemy soldiers have got lots of new dying animations. Enemy archers' AI system is changed! Archers can shoot better and predict where will our Dragon fly. It is more challenging now ;)

[h3]New Challenges on the Map![/h3]
We have got lots of new challenges on the map now. While you are running in the forest or flying with your dragon above the forest, you might face with Neutral Dragons who want to protect its area. Or you can face with Enemy Camps, Enemy War Ships or Watch Towers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/86ed6546c32c62fea44fbf380fb37fdf9db69860.jpg[/img]
We have got Enemy Watch Towers are around all the forest and mountains with this new version!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/d1e42f7599158f5f239f04424872403d2856bffd.jpg[/img]
There are lots of Neutral Dragons who want to protect its area against you in this new version!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/a961890ac2b685e061c9818e40be465d27049b44.jpg[/img]
You can face with lots of Enemy War Ships. They petrol around the island and docks.


[h3]Performance Optimizations![/h3]
I am happy to say that I have made lots of Performance optimizations on Objects, Shadows and Meshes and I have used my own Performance Optimization Asset for this. You can use it for your own games as well: https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/utilities/4-optimization-tools-in-1-mesh-combiner-baker-mesh-optimizer-obj-236754


I hope you like the new version. I am working on the project and planning to bring new suprises for you in the next update.

Kind Regards,
Queen Developer <3

notes.title: Version 3 is Released! World of Dragon is more Exciting now!
notes.content:
Come and fight for your Village! For your Father! And for your family's honor! On the Wings V3 is released with lots of new improvements dear Dragon and Adventure lovers. We had lots of progress especially on Visual side with URP upgrade, Ambient Occulusion Effect and Beautify 3 Package.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/022e60465f48e8a076cc869fee6526f841980cef.jpg[/img]

What have I done in this new version:
- Fixed some Language Translation Mistakes.
- Main Menu Visuals are Improved!
- Performance Optimization.
- Dragon Models, Village Environment, Nature Props and Firing Particles are improved visually and They are looking much better now.
- Universal Renderer Pipeline is upgraded!
- Weapon Put In and Out Animations are correctly being animated now while player is running.
- Day - Night Loop is optimized and working better with Shadows now.
- Blood VFX system is changed completely. Now blood effects look much better and realistic.
- NPC AI system is improved.
- New Sound effects are added.
- Various Bugs in the Game are fixed.

notes.title: Get ready for final battle with Dark Rider and to save your captive father!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/25d992a2eb64e85bbc399ab678f1d79fced7df5c.jpg[/img]

Get ready for final battle with Dark Rider and to save your captive father! I have done lots of improvements and bug fixings. You can read the changes and improvements as listed below:

[list]
[*] Sword and Shield put on and put off animations are added!
[*] Some improvements have been made on Performance Optimizations.
[*] Quest Pointer Arrow logic is improved.
[*] Some of Dragon Animations are improved (Healing, First Meeting, Rotating, etc...)
[*] Bone system of Ursula has been fixed.
[*] Main Menu animations, environments and lights are improved.
[*] Some translation mistakes are corrected.
[*] Some major and minor bugs are fixed.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/e1b13610a27b2811eeb106c14c4f773e29312b0a.jpg[/img]


4 New exciting levels are added into the game. Your dragon can't help you in the deep of the dungeons. This time you are alone until you go out from castle:

[list]
[*] Solve the puzzle in front of Dark Rider's castle and enter there without fear!
[*] Eliminate all guards and find your way in the dungeons!
[*] Find the magical stones, put them on dungeon door, save your father and escape from castle!
[*] Defeat the army of Dark Rider. They will march to your Village.
[*] Bring your father to your mother and be a family again.
[/list]

notes.title: DRAGONS ARE IN DANGER! ENEMIES CATAPULTS HAVE ARRIVED TO ISLAND!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/e0e2b9a1fdc3f0b1cd7c5dcca6144e28fc745e68.jpg[/img]

Hello everybody! Excitement on the Sky continues with new features. I am analyzing your valuable reviews carefully and updating my game constantly. New features and bug fixes are listed below:

[list]
[*] CATAPULTS have arrived! Now the battle between enemies and dragons are balanced better. They are firing back to you and defending themselves with heavy fireballs!
[*] Mother Dragon Quest is changed. Now, instead of stealing dragon eggs from mother dragon, we are saving them from hunter dragon by not killing, only knocking down it.
[*] NPC Talking Animations are added!
[*] Minor bugs are fixed.
[*] Attack to Dark Rider's Castle Quest is added! Believe me it won't be easy because more than 28 enemy archers and catapults are defending his Castle! :)
[*] Quest and Dialog Translations are improved!
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer - Dev Blog 1 - Exciting News!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285058/971bf98d1a7d7ac7a2166279c042734ba0102e04.gif[/img]

Queen Developer is working hard for you. :) Let's talk about the current progress about Multiplayer modes in On the Wings - Birth of a Hero. The game will have 3 different Multiplayer modes in the future. These are:
[list]
[*] Death Match
[*] Battle Royal
[*] Team Match
[/list]
Each mode's gameplay will be unique and fun! Currently, I am working on development of Single Player Story (Almost finished!) and development of foundations of Multiplayer modes. You can find the completed development list of Multiplayer modes below:
[list]
[*] Creating Room
[*] Joining Room
[*] Basic Transform (Positions, Rotations, Scales, Movements, etc..) Communications between Players
[*] Dragon and Character Animations (Running, Walking, Hitting, Swimming, Riding, Flying, Diving, Shooting, Swinging, etc...)
[*] Breating Fireballs and Shooting rivals mechanics
[*] Nickname UI Displaying
[*] Flying and Riding Dragons together
[*] Voice Chat between Players
[*] Current Score Board UI by pressing Tab Button
[/list]
As being only Developer, It is difficult to develop both Multiplayer modes and Single Player Storyline after putting the kids to sleep. So, I definitely need your support and feedbacks my valuable players.

notes.title: Much Better with the new Update!
notes.content:
Hi everybody! :) I have done so many improvements and bug fixings. Thank you so much for your valuable feedbacks. New updates includes things listed below:

[list]
[*] Infinite falling down in caves bug is fixed!
[*] Holding multiple torch in one hand is fixed!
[*] Occulusion Culling problems are fixed!
[*] Ridiculous Climbing on Buildings bug is fixed! :D
[*] Dragons' Level and Coin Requirements are reduced (Now, it is easier to take high skilled dragons)
[*] Sound effects are added into Tavern
[*] You can't use your weapons or call your dragons anymore while you are swimming in the sea. :D
[*] Enemy Archers are more stable and powerful now (Fear them)
[*] Missing Localization words are completed!
[*] Now, it is easier to reach Controls Guideline in Options Panel.
[/list] 

I am working hard on completing the story and having good progress on Multiplayer side currently. Stay tuned guys!

notes.title: Gamepad Controller Support and Improvements 🥳
notes.content:
Hi everybody! I have published a comprehensive update. 🥳 You can find the details below:

1. I hope, now the game supports fully Gamepad controllers 🙂 🎮 
2. When dragon fire collides with water, now we see a big splash on the water 🌊 
3. Boss Pirate Ship properties are improved. Now, they are smarter. As soon as they see you and your dragon, they blow the war horn and start to move. 🎺 
4. There are enemy and pirate campfires on map now. You can attack them. 🔥 
5. Minor and Mid level bugs are fixed. 🦟
